d: Foreign investors have pulled a record $31 billion out of Indian stocks this year, putting pressure on the country’s equity markets. Now, the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has reportedly recommended scrapping the long-term capital gains tax for foreign investors ahead of the February 2027 Budget. In this video, Firstpost explains how the 12.5% tax works, why SEBI wants it removed and how India’s tax treatment compares with markets such as China, Indonesia, Vietnam and Brazil. The video also examines the other costs foreign investors face, how scrapping the tax could improve…
